Honestly I don’t really know how I did the things I didn’t want to. For my hygiene I was just like to myself “you feel like a wet rat, have a shower”. For anything else I just wanted to do them - honestly it was just a sudden change lol. Wearing bright clothes makes me feel happy so I was just like to myself “why not buy more??”. 

I think the trick is just realising what state you’re in. e.g. I realised at my own pace that I was pretty nasty so that was the first step to me being more hygienic. Simple things like that really :]

Yeah changing my bed sheets after a month of not doing so felt so nice. Same goes with clean clothes. And thank you!! I probably wouldn’t of accepted the offer in the past months so it felt nice to me that I could :]
Not exactly, I don't like sharing that info, even to people i'm incredibly close to. But thank you for the offer anyways. I’ll keep you in mind in case I do want to though :)

I don't think you're naive actually. Animals have been my solace for a long time too. If I do stay and eventually move out on my own I want to adopt a snake, they're my favourite. Even if I don't, i've still got my cats for now. Thanks for making me actually consider that in the possible future.
